anti_overfit_boundary: No coefficient, threshold, world, seed, race, or stratum changes after scoring.
No selector or adaptive-mixture tuning in this experiment.
No real/historical data, odds, prices, RESULT/PAYOUT, ROI, or bankroll inputs.
A failed N1 gate authorizes only a separately preregistered synthetic component-development experiment, not post-hoc repair inside v5.

decision_rule.c0_W0_reference_adequate: C0_SCORE_PL has the lowest W0 mean KL on both seeds.
n1_W2_component_adequate: N1_CONDITIONAL W2 mean KL <= 0.95 * min(C0_SCORE_PL, C1_LINE_PL) W2 mean KL on both seeds.
For every LOW/MID/HIGH stratum with count >= 60 on each seed, N1 W2 stratum KL <= 1.02 * best PL W2 stratum KL.

purpose: Test whether the fixed C0 and N1 synthetic forecasting components are actually adequate for the W0 and W2 oracle components before any further selector/adaptive-mixture tuning.
